articles.summary: First Quarter with Combined Company Operations; Integration Well Underway Approximately $30 Million in Annualized Cost Synergies Identified Company Issues Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook ATLANTA, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Katapult Holdings, Inc. (“Katapult Holdings” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: KPLT), a scaled, technology and data-driven platform serving nonprime consumers seeking greater financial flexibility, today reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “Our first quarter with combined company operations marks an important milestone for Katapult Holdings and was defined by speed of execution,” said Cory Miller, CEO of Katapult Holdings. “Since closing the merger in August, our teams have hit the ground running, and I want to thank everyone across our brands for their hard work and dedication. articles.title: Katapult Holdings Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
